user_query: Identify this protein from its amino-acid sequence and estimate biological process involvement. Report sequence properties, strongest annotated homologs and alignment evidence, curated function/GO/pathway/localization annotations, and distinguish direct annotation from homology-based inference.

warnings: Sequence-derived estimates assume an unmodified protein and do not account for processing, PTMs, bound ligands, or oligomers.
